introduction.p: Let f(x)=\sin(x) and let T_3(x)=c_0+c_1x+c_2x^2+c_3x^3\text{.} We find the values of c_0,\ldots,c_3 that make the sine function and its derivative values agree with those of the cubic polynomial T_3 at x=0\text{,} and observe patterns in the derivatives.
